title: The bottom dock, chords that stay put, and notes without the browser
thisBuild: A bar along the bottom of the Play, My Desk and Synth tabs stays on screen however far down you scroll: Menu for the picked pad, Hold, Chords on or off, and the key button. The key button opens root, scale, chord type, Hold's count and Let go just above the bar.
Menu is the one way to a pad's menu now. A hold on a pad always plays, on every kind of pad. Moving a pad's sound is in the menu: Move to another pad, then tap where it goes.

Chords: Chords on the bottom bar flips between chords and single notes and remembers which chords you had. Chords keep their root on the bottom, so G is G B D on every key. The Padiano and the Roll reach from C1 to C6 (Oct buttons), so chords play and record as written.

Chord sets work the Maschine way: with a set on, the Padiano shows the set's chords as named boxes, always in the same order, so box 3 of Sunday Pop is always Am. Oct moves the whole set. On the Keys grid, the bottom two rows are the set and the top two the same set an octave up. Two new chord types: 1-4-5 (the sus sound) and Octaves.
Empty pads have a slash: tap above it to record onto the pad, below it to pick a sound. The Settings switch for this is gone.
Steps: slide along a row to paint it (start on an empty step to fill, on a full one to erase). Names in the Steps list get two lines.
Repeat has 1/4. Triplets and dotted come with the LFO build, because they need a new clock in the engine.
The Repeat lesson starts on its first step, and Back waits for you instead of jumping forward. Every lesson starts with Repeat and chords off and puts them back after.
MIDI map: One at a time waits for you to tap the next target after each key (Run is the old way). List shows every key and knob on the map, with Teach to redo one and an x to take one off.

The bug button sits in the bottom left corner of every page. The note box opens on the kind of note you sent last, with big buttons. Send without the browser: paste a GitHub key once (steps are in the note box) and Send posts the note from inside the app. Notes written offline wait and go out later.
watch: The bottom dock on the cover screen at your view size: does it fit, and is Menu where your thumb wants it?
Chord sets on the Padiano and the Keys grid, by ear: do the boxes feel like Maschine's chord sets, and are the chords voiced well?
Paint a row of steps with one slide, then scroll the Steps page: does a slide up or down still scroll, and a slide sideways still paint?
Make the GitHub key and send one note with it. If GitHub refuses the key, the app says so.
limits: A MIDI key plays chord set slots 1 to 7 by its place in the scale; the 8th chord is on the Padiano's boxes only. MIDI round two adds slots to the map.
The hold menus on a sound's name in Steps and Roll are still there; the pads have none.

Triplet and dotted Repeat, the FannyPack, the FX and LFO strips, the pitch wheel, Steps row tools and Step mode, MIDI round two, the speed guide, What the FAQ and the automation view come in the next builds.
I cannot hear the app: chord voicings and the slot sound are for your ears.
